text:
support-eli: FYI — Copperfield reported ~2.5x p99 on text-gen this morning after the runtime roll. Customer timeline: p99 went from ~1.2s -> ~3.1s around 02:10 UTC. They quoted user impact on the checkout feature. :frowning:

jamal: Oof. Do we have traces from their requests? Is this across all regions or just us-east-1? :eyes:

support-eli: Only us-east for now. Attached logs from their request replay (anonymized):
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:10Z] req=abc123 model=gpt-rlhf-v2-4k latency_ms=3100 stage=decode
[2026-03-15T02:12:10Z] req=abc124 model=gpt-rlhf-v2-4k latency_ms=2950 stage=kv_cache_fetch
```

alex: Can someone run a quick reproducer against staging w/ the same model + seq len distribution? If it's decode/kv_cache_fetch, might be a kernel selector or batching regression.

maya: I'm leaning kernel selector change — I saw a commit touching kernel selection heuristics in the 2026-03-14 deploy (sha: b3c9f6d). Jamal, can you check the selector logs on the affected node? There's a verbose flag: KSELECTOR_LOG=1

jamal: On it. Also can we get a flamegraph from a repro run? I'll kick off an nsys profile on one node.

lucy: I'll do a targeted load replay in staging with the customer's input distribution. PR replay job id: replay-6421. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/replays/replay-6421 (internal). I'll run with 100rps for 10m to hit tails.

sre-oncall: If this is widespread, we should consider routing Copperfield to the q4_k_m variant for immediate mitigation (lower perf but smaller latency). Can we set a route rule for them for the next 30m?

ken: +1 for temporary routing. Also check autoscaler queue depth — I saw queue_len spike in the dashboard earlier: p95 queue_len=18 -> 45 during the regression window. That can amplify tail latencies.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: runtime-service roll v2026-03-14 (sha b3c9f6d) promoted to production at 2026-03-14T22:30Z.

jamal: nsys profile started, collecting 120s. Uploading to perf bucket: s3://perf-redwood/runs/2026-03-15/nsys-6421.tar.gz

jamal: Quick peek at flamegraph: heavy spend in attention backward kernel for seq>1024. But decode is hot too. Link: https://perf.redwood/internal/flame/nsys-6421 (internal). :thinking_face:

maya: That matches a change I made to chunked-attn fallback heuristics — if sequence length distribution has a long tail we can hit a less-optimized kernel path. I'll review my PR. If it's that, reverting the heuristics or forcing chunked-attn for flagged models should fix p99.

alex: Action items:
- jamal: finish full profile and post perf artifacts (nsys, flame, callgrind) -> due 30m
- lucy: complete replay in staging + produce joint p50/p95/p99 table -> due 45m
- maya: diff b3c9f6d changes and prepare rollback/patch -> due 30m
- ken/sre-oncall: prepare routing rule to q4_k_m and a canary route for 5% -> please be ready to flip

support-eli: I'll keep Copperfield updated and prepare a support-facing mitigation note if we route them.

lucy: Replay results (staging, synthetic): p50=180ms p95=480ms p99=2.9s (matches production tail). Attaching hist: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/replay-6421/hist.png

jamal: Full profile uploaded. Short summary: kernel selector chose fallback GEMM kernel for large-attn during decode for ~12% of tokens, which increases per-token latency by ~20-40ms. Also saw occasional CPU-side scheduling pauses correlated with high queue_len.

maya: Confirmed — my change widened the threshold that falls back to the GEMM path for large tokens. I have a patch to restore previous threshold + add a telemetry gate. Submitting PR now (PR: rwd/kernel-selector#198).

ken: If we rollback selector heuristics, what's risk? Any perf regressions for other models?

maya: Risk is small; we'll gate the change to the specific model family (gpt-*-4k) for now. I can do a canary rollout 10% in us-east-1 then ramp.

sre-oncall: Let's do both mitigations: route Copperfield to q4_k_m + canary patch. Routing will reduce user p99 now, patch will fix root cause. I'll coordinate the routing change.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: kernel-selector patch -> canary us-east-1 10% in 20m (if PR approved).

jamal: After routing Copperfield to q4_k_m their replay p99 dropped to 900ms in a short test. :thumbsup:

support-eli: I'll tell Copperfield we have a mitigation and a fix in canary. Thanks team.

alex: Great work. After patch stabilizes, let's add a targeted regression test (seq distribution including long tails) to the runtime perf CI and a perf monitor alert for kernel-selector fallback rates.

lucy: Agreed — I'll add the replay as a nightly perf job.

maya: PR up, requesting reviews: @jamal @alex @ken.

jamal: Reviewing now.

sre-oncall: Keeping monitoring on for next 2 hours. If p99 stays down we'll close the incident and schedule postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
